verdict.rationale: Call recording and transcript retrieval is a fair question for a voice-agent framework with telephony support, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of recording, egress, transcript storage, or any API for retrieving recordings or transcripts per call. The telephony and programmatic-participant docs describe handling calls, not capturing or exporting them.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call
